integrity: The facet list, boundary ranks, missing-triangle census, homology classes, generated symmetry group, and symmetry orbits are independently recomputed by the embedded standalone verifier. Finite enumeration is used only for this finite complex.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for one labeled 15-vertex triangulation and for simple mod-two edge cycles. The 1986 construction article was inspected through its abstract and bibliographic record, not readable full text; the first day-resolved public date used here is the 2003 arXiv posting, because the 1986 record is only month-resolved in the inspected material.
title: Two symmetry orbits exhaust the mod-two one-systoles of the 15-vertex quaternionic space
